sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Prestige system in Escape from Tarkov which only exists in the PvP game mode, allows players to start the game again from the beginning, only keeping their profile statistics, achievements, Arena ARP rating and armory progress as well as a percentage of character skills and weapon mastering. Some items can also be transferred, while the amount and allowed item types increase with each Prestige. Prestige levels and rewards persist throughout game profile resets and remain forever.

sections.heading: Conditions
sections.text:
To earn a Prestige level, the following conditions have to be fulfilled:

| Prestige level | PMC level | Quests completed | Objectives within story chapters | Skills | Hideout upgrades | Items |
| Prestige 1 | 25 | New Beginning (Prestige 1) | N/A | N/A | Intelligence Center level 1; Nutrition Unit level 2; Rest Space level 2 | 10,000,000 Roubles |
| Prestige 2 | 30 | New Beginning (Prestige 2) | Complete Tour | Strength skill level 10; Endurance skill level 10; Charisma skill level 7 | Intelligence Center level 1; Nutrition Unit level 2; Rest Space level 2 | 15,000,000 Roubles |
| Prestige 3 | 35 | New Beginning (Prestige 3) | Complete Tour; Complete Falling Skies | Strength skill level 10; Endurance skill level 10; Charisma skill level 7 | Intelligence Center level 1; Nutrition Unit level 2; Rest Space level 2 | 15,000,000 Roubles |
| Prestige 4 | 40 | New Beginning (Prestige 4) | Complete Tour; Obtain the Ticket from Tarkov | Strength skill level 15; Endurance skill level 15; Charisma skill level 12 | Intelligence Center level 1; Nutrition Unit level 2; Rest Space level 2 | 15,000,000 Roubles |
| Prestige 5 | 47 | New Beginning (Prestige 5); Collector | Complete Tour; Complete They Are Already Here; Obtain the Ticket from Tarkov | Strength skill level 20; Endurance skill level 20; Charisma skill level 20 | Intelligence Center level 2; Security level 3; Rest Space level 3 | 20,000,000 Roubles |
| Prestige 6 | 47 | New Beginning (Prestige 6); Collector | Complete The Ticket | Strength skill level 20; Endurance skill level 20; Charisma skill level 20 | Intelligence Center level 2; Security level 3; Rest Space level 3 | 20,000,000 Roubles |

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Each prestige level comes with a special dogtag, armband, achievement and an icon shown in the player profile as well as next to the nickname. Unlocked rewards are also available in the PvE game mode.
